definitions: Any of various tropical climbing plants of the genus Hoya, native to Asia and Australia, having waxy leaves and clusters of fragrant, star-shaped flowers.
A plant belonging to the genus Hoya, often cultivated as a houseplant for its attractive foliage and flowers.
examples: The hoya is a popular houseplant.
She has several varieties of hoya in her collection.
The hoya bloomed beautifully this year.
